Four iwans: how the madrasa plan works

Four halls around one court

  • A court open to the sky
  • Four vaulted iwans face it, one on each side
  • One hall for each school of law
S
In a madrasa each hall could hold one school of law, which is why the plan spread so quickly across the region.
